description: Email-native HITL approval gate. Sends the outbound approval-request email via SMTP; polls a shared mailbox via IMAP for replies matching approve/reject keywords from allowlisted approvers; writes the standard JSON approval token on quorum. Composes with HumanApprovalGateComponent via a shared approval_dir. Works over local FS or any fsspec URI (s3:// / gs:// / abfs://) — Dagster+ Serverless-safe (no incoming webhooks required).

inputs.description: One upstream asset whose text is emailed to approvers.

outputs.description: Two Dagster definitions: a `{asset_name}_posted` asset (sends the email + writes sidecar state) and a `{asset_name}_watcher` sensor (polls IMAP + writes JSON approval token on quorum).

upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset whose text is emailed for approval. String (not AssetKey object); multi-part keys use slash notation.
upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key

approval_dir.label: Approval Directory
approval_dir.description: Local path or fsspec URI (s3://, gs://, abfs://).

smtp_username_env_var.description: Env var holding the SMTP username (usually the from-email).
smtp_username_env_var.label: SMTP Username Env Var

smtp_password_env_var.description: Env var holding the SMTP password (app password for Gmail; account password elsewhere).
smtp_password_env_var.label: SMTP Password Env Var

from_email.description: `From:` address on the outbound approval request.
from_email.label: From Email

to_emails.description: Recipient emails. Everyone here gets the request.
to_emails.label: To Emails

cc_emails.description: Optional CC list (typically escalation contacts or auditors).
cc_emails.label: CC Emails

imap_username_env_var.description: Env var holding the IMAP username (often same as SMTP username).
imap_username_env_var.label: IMAP Username Env Var

imap_password_env_var.description: Env var holding the IMAP password (often same as SMTP password).
imap_password_env_var.label: IMAP Password Env Var

approve_keyword.description: Case-insensitive. Match in subject (`[APPROVE ...]`) or first body line.
approve_keyword.label: Approve Keyword

reject_keyword.description: Case-insensitive. Match in subject (`[REJECT ...]`) or first body line.
reject_keyword.label: Reject Keyword

required_approvers.description: How many allowlisted approvers must reply approve before the token is written.
required_approvers.label: Required Approvers

approver_allowlist.label: Approver Allowlist
approver_allowlist.description: Email addresses. Replies from anyone else are ignored.

timeout_hours.description: Optional. If quorum isn't reached within this many hours, applies `on_timeout` policy.
timeout_hours.label: Timeout Hours

on_timeout.description: `escalate` (default — CC escalation contact on a follow-up email, keep waiting) \| `reject` (auto-reject) \| `approve` (auto-approve — use with caution).
on_timeout.label: On Timeout

escalate_email.label: Escalate Email
escalate_email.description: CC'd on the escalation follow-up. Only used when on_timeout=escalate.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Sensor cadence — how often to poll IMAP for new replies. 60s default; lower for demos, higher for shared corporate mailboxes with rate limits.
poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval (s)

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

name: Email Approval Gate
